name: run-data-pipeline
title: Run Data Pipeline
author: mpandav
description: Runs a pipeline of a Flogo Data Pipeline engine through its REST API: starts the run (params, input path, overlap policy, result callback) and waits for its result, or returns once the engine has taken it. The run joins the flow's trace.

display.description: Run a data pipeline from a flow and get its result

inputs.name: engineUrl
inputs.description: Base URL of the data pipeline engine's REST API, e.g. http://orders-etl.data:9080 (map from an app property)

inputs.name: apiToken
inputs.description: The engine's DP_API_TOKEN — a deployed engine runs pipelines only for a caller that has it (map from a secret app property)

inputs.name: pipeline
inputs.description: The pipeline: its name (daily-tx) or its ref (res://pipeline:daily-tx)

inputs.name: runId
inputs.description: The run's id; empty: a new one. A run id still in flight is not run twice — the activity follows that run — and a checkpointed run given the id of one that stopped resumes where it stopped

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Values for the ${…} of the pipeline's source path, e.g. {"date": "2026-11-12"}

inputs.name: inputPath
inputs.description: Replaces the pipeline's source path for this run (a file a partner dropped)

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: wait: return the run's result once it has ended; start: return once the engine has taken the run (status running or queued)

inputs.name: overlap
inputs.description: While a run of the pipeline is in flight — allow: run alongside it; skip: do not run (status skipped); queue: wait for it, then run

inputs.name: callbackUrl
inputs.description: Where the engine posts the run's result as it ends (a flow's REST trigger) — must be under the engine's DP_API_CALLBACK_URLS

inputs.name: waitTimeoutSeconds
inputs.description: wait mode: how long to wait for the result; a run that outlasts it goes on, and the activity fails with DATAPIPELINE-4005

inputs.name: pollIntervalSeconds
inputs.description: wait mode: how often to ask the engine how the run goes

inputs.name: failOnRunFailure
inputs.description: A run that ends failed or cancelled fails the activity (DATAPIPELINE-4004, the run in $error.data); false: read status instead

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: completed, partial, failed or cancelled — running or queued in start mode — or skipped when the engine did not run it (overlap skip while the pipeline ran, a suspended pipeline)

outputs.name: rowsFailed
outputs.description: Rows that failed: dead-lettered or rejected

outputs.name: rowsDropped
outputs.description: Rows a stage dropped on purpose (a filter)

outputs.name: durationMs
outputs.description: How long the run took, in milliseconds

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Why the run failed, was cancelled or skipped; for a partial run, the first reason rows failed

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The run as the engine reports it, every field: validationReport, stageTimings, graphStats, …
